source.operator_quote: CR uses lists recommendation as long as this is in compliance with the handbook

decisions.question: CR zone use lists: 40.10.20.10(1)(A) stays as M-100 rules; 40.10.20.10(1)(B) takes the CHAT-182 informational form; both leave the G1 round
decisions.recommendation: The card's recommendation, applied in compliance with handbook m.100 / M-100. 40.10.20.10(1)#(1)(A) (the 'c' use list of named non-residential uses) stays keyed as M-100 rules: PERMIT, application.building_types [non_residential_building]; it takes no CHAT-178 specific-use keying and leaves the G1 round's set (it is a ruled use-list PERMIT, not a stray non-dwelling clause). 40.10.20.10(1)#(1)(B) (the 'r' use list, which includes 'Dwelling Unit in a permitted building type in Clause 40.10.20.40') is keyed in the CHAT-182 form: PROCEDURAL / informational, deferring to the zone's building-type list and never PERMITting a type alone, so no CR dwelling permission is removed; M-100 names (A) only, so (B) is outside it. Effect: 0 Layer 2 cells (chapter 40 has no MaxBLD residential zone, M-159(1)); the G1 round lands its other 48 units (44 corrections + 4 already school).
